item.title: Pakistan Imported $175 Million Worth of Cars and Auto Parts in January
item.description: Pakistan’s motor vehicle import bill stood at $175.6 million in January 2026, up 23.49% year-on-year but down 16.02% compared to December, covering fully built imported cars (CBUs), parts for locally assembled vehicles (CKD kits), and spare parts, according to the latest data released by the State Bank of Pakistan. item.title: No More Challans on Private Number Plates in Punjab
item.description: The Excise, Taxation & Narcotics Control Department, Punjab, has abolished centralized manufacturing of government-issued number plates across the province.
